findings.claim: 2026-05-12 eBay 董事會就 GameStop 主動提出、不具約束力的收購提案發布回應新聞稿（8-K Item 8.01）；搜尋摘要顯示提案約每股 $125、估值約 $555 億，待核

findings.excerpt: On October 20, 2026, the Company announced the Plan, which includes a reduction of the Company’s current global workforce by approximately 9%.
